summary: Tested full backend API (17 pytest cases) and key frontend flows (landing, login, register w/ role, explore + filters + map view, property detail w/ map & booking, dashboards). 16/17 backend tests pass; the 1 failure is a test-side issue (server correctly lowercases emails, expected behavior). Frontend works end-to-end. Seeded users + 6 Bangalore properties present.

minor.issue: Returned email is lowercased while caller may send mixed case. Test assertion updated to compare lowercased. This is correct server behaviour, just noted for clarity.
Endpoint allows ANY khatta to verify ANY tenant document (no ownership/property linkage check). Acceptable for MVP but should be tightened.
No ownership check before updating rent record status (any authenticated user can update any record).
allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject; relying on env CORS_ORIGINS - works in current preview but should be explicit.

issues: Uses browser-native datetime input (mm/dd/yyyy, --:-- --) instead of a shadcn calendar/date-picker component. Visually inconsistent with the rest of the design language.
Two empty stat card slots between Available and Pending Visits (and trailing empty card) — wastes layout space.
A third blank stat card is rendered next to 'Saved Properties' and 'Upcoming Visits' — should either be filled (e.g., Unread Messages) or removed.

action_items: Replace native datetime-local input in PropertyDetail booking form with a shadcn DatePicker for design consistency.
Add ownership/property-linkage check in PATCH /api/documents/{id}/verify (e.g. only the property owner whose tenant submitted the doc, or admin).
Add ownership check in PATCH /api/rent-records/{rid} so only the owning khatta can update.
Fill or remove the empty stat-card placeholders on Khatta and Meetha dashboards (e.g. show Rent Collected / Unread Messages).
Tighten CORS_ORIGINS to explicit origins in production env.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~815-line file mixing auth, properties, chat, reviews, uploads, admin. Should be split into routers/services for maintainability.
init_storage uses a module-level cached storage_key but is invoked synchronously inside async endpoints via requests (blocking). Use httpx.AsyncClient.
All upload/file fetch endpoints are blocking (requests.put/get) inside async handlers — will block the FastAPI event loop under load.

DELETE /api/favorites/{pid} & POST /api/favorites have no audit and silently 'succeed' on missing rows — acceptable, but POST returns {'ok': true} both for new save AND duplicate; consider returning created flag.
JWT cookie uses samesite='none' with secure=true; fine for cross-site but ensure cookie path/site stays consistent if domain changes.
Password reset 'dev_token' is returned in response body — should be gated behind APP_ENV != 'production'.
No rate-limiting / brute-force lockout on /auth/login (collection login_attempts exists in test_credentials.md but is unused in code).
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_* prefixed properties, reviews, appointments, favorites created during tests in TestCity and as 1 review on a property. Safe to ignore or clean up later.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers auth (register/login/forgot-reset), properties CRUD + filters + nearby haversine, appointments, favorites, messages, reviews+rating aggregate, upload+file fetch, documents, dashboards, admin. Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. UI testids confirmed: login-email/password/submit, register-name/email/password/submit, role-khatta, filter-q, filter-apply, view-map exist and work. PropertyDetail uses Leaflet (.leaflet-container).
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs found. Single backend test failure (TestAuth.test_register_khatta_and_me) was due to test asserting raw casing while server (correctly) lowercases emails on register. Fix in test if desired, but server behaviour is correct.
